name: Vesalius College (Brussels School of Governance)
englishBachelors: Fully English-taught bachelor's in business, international affairs and communication
note: Founded with VUB, it offers an entirely English-taught, American-style liberal arts bachelor's - but it charges private-college tuition rather than the public EU rate. It has not existed under its own name since February 2021, when it merged with the Institute for European Studies to form the Brussels School of Governance. The degrees are taught, awarded and advertised as Brussels School of Governance BA programmes. Its published IB line is 27 points with no specific subjects required.
summary: English-taught college in Brussels, now the Brussels School of Governance: three BAs in international affairs, business and law, at €15,000 a year.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 27 points; no specific subjects required and no English test. Admission is selective: motivation essay, CV and transcripts, plus a €90 application fee.

Applications for Fall 2027 BA programmes open

programmes.name: BA in Global Business and Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: The functions of a global company with an entrepreneurial bent, plus Python, data analysis and responsible use of AI, taught in small interactive classes with group projects, a capstone and internships in Brussels.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective, holistic review: at least 27 IB points, then your transcripts, motivation essay, CV and activities. Some applicants are offered the preparatory year instead.

programmes.name: BA in International Affairs
programmes.about: Politics, economics, law and history applied to European and international relations, in small interactive classes with practitioners from EU and international institutions and internships in Brussels.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective, holistic review: at least 27 IB points, then your transcripts, motivation essay, CV and activities. Some applicants are offered the preparatory year instead.

programmes.name: BA in International and European Law
programmes.about: International and EU law, from human rights and migration to trade and business law, with legal writing and moot-court advocacy; 90 to 132 credits are law. It does not by itself qualify you to practise.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective, holistic review: at least 27 IB points, then your transcripts, motivation essay, CV and activities. Some applicants are offered the preparatory year instead.

notes: Tuition is €7,500 a semester for EEA and non-EEA students alike; merit scholarships cut it by up to 50%, applied for by 1 March for autumn entry.
The deadline page gives 30 June for EEA citizens starting in autumn, without naming a year; you can also start in the spring semester in January.
The degree is awarded by Vesalius College; the Brussels School of Governance is its alliance with VUB's Institute for European Studies.
